title: Graham Hancock's text doubting the Giza SAR source

tellings.quote: I texted Graham Hancock about it. He said, "I have no reason to um believe that the source here is being honest."

plain: In 2025 the writer Graham Hancock said he did not trust the source behind a claim about radar scans of the Giza plateau, the site of Egypt's Great Pyramids. The scans were made with SAR, a kind of radar imaging, and the claim was tied to a researcher named Filippo Biondi. Michels says he texted Hancock about it, and Hancock replied: "I have no reason to believe that the source here is being honest."
